decision: Adopt correctness-first, reproducible performance budgets and observable noninterference gates. Denial alone is not proof of privacy: zero side effects, consent-scoped cross-zone flow, and effective revocation must be measured. Numerical latency/memory budgets remain provisional hypotheses until the Ladybird vertical slice is measured on a pinned reference machine. No external benchmark score target is set before the required APIs and workloads are genuinely supported.

measurement_protocol.cold_run_rule: Each cold-start sample uses a fresh process. Warm-state benchmarks declare their warmup and reuse policy.
measurement_protocol.regression_policy: Do not activate numeric regression screening until at least 30 valid baseline samples and 30 valid matched blocks exist on the same reference environment. A provisional signal is >5% median or >10% p95 versus that baseline, must exceed measured noise, and should be confirmed independently. A release-blocking performance decision requires at least 100 valid paired blocks per workload, the declared confidence/multiple-comparison procedure, and an independent confirmatory campaign.
measurement_protocol.comparison_policy: Matched hardware, engine revision, workload revision, viewport, power state and runner methodology are mandatory. Publish per-workload results and raw samples; never compare across benchmark versions as if equivalent.
measurement_protocol.result_policy: Performance claims require correct output first. WPT correctness, privacy, security, crash stability, latency, throughput, memory and energy are separate evidence classes.
measurement_protocol.privacy_policy: No page bodies, cookies, credentials or visited-URL histories in benchmark artifacts by default; fixtures are synthetic/local and opt-in evidence is explicit.
measurement_protocol.comparison_design: Default to matched blocks on one reference host. Within each block run baseline and candidate in randomized AB/BA order with a published deterministic seed and no overlapping benchmark processes; define state resets and cache policy in the suite manifest. Keep cold-start and warm-state measurements separate. If pairing is infeasible, label the comparison unpaired and require independent repeated confirmation before gating.
measurement_protocol.drift_policy: Retain monotonic sample order; report first-half and second-half medians, robust dispersion and every raw sample. If temporal drift is distinguishable from within-run dispersion or if power/thermal/background state changes, mark the campaign unstable and repeat. Do not average drift away or post-hoc discard outliers; any numeric drift cutoff must be suite-specific and pre-registered.
measurement_protocol.campaign_policy: One batch contains the declared warmups and 10 measured paired blocks. Pool at least three independently started batches (at least 30 valid pairs) before producing a screening regression signal. Release-blocking performance decisions require at least 100 valid paired blocks per workload and a separate confirmatory campaign; fewer observations are descriptive/exploratory only.
measurement_protocol.multiple_comparison_policy: Pre-register the primary metric and effect threshold for each suite. For all simultaneously release-blocking metrics, report effect size and a 95% paired bootstrap confidence interval from at least 10000 resamples with a recorded seed, and apply Holm-Bonferroni control at the declared familywise alpha. A release block requires the pre-registered practical regression threshold, adjusted statistical evidence and independent confirmation; nominal p-values or intervals alone are not sufficient.

suites.source: Prism-owned deterministic fixture manifest with a pinned digest

metrics.pass_condition: Every fixture declared supported by the current manifest passes.
No unexpected failure is accepted in the declared supported set.
Every declared case has an explicit outcome; missing is not success.

suites.method: Run deterministic local fixtures without public-network dependency; preserve one result record per manifest case.
suites.notes: Harness contract only until the real Ladybird-backed fixture runner exists.

suites.source: Pinned Web Platform Tests revision and reviewed Prism-supported manifest

metrics.pass_condition: 100% of the explicitly declared required/supported WPT cases pass.
No new unexpected failures within the declared supported set.
Pass, fail, timeout, unsupported, skipped and not-run counts reconcile to the manifest.

suites.method: Pin WPT commit and manifest; retain raw machine-readable output; report outcomes separately per spec area.
suites.notes: Never present a subset score as overall browser compatibility. WPT is a correctness/conformance lane, not a performance score.

suites.source: Prism broker policy fixtures and adversarial malformed/unauthorized requests

metrics.pass_condition: Every unauthorized or malformed privileged request is denied or rejected safely.
No negative control obtains privileged access.

suites.method: Use explicit allow/deny expectations, malformed payloads, origin/context mismatches and revoked capability cases. Measure latency separately.
suites.notes: Performance optimization must never weaken a fail-closed security result.

suites.source: Adversarial broker requests with before/after snapshots of broker-owned state, share queues, privileged-action records and observable egress

metrics.pass_condition: Denied, malformed, expired or unauthorized requests cause zero durable state changes, share-queue writes, privileged actions or outbound flows.
No PRIVATE or LOCAL data reaches a PUBLIC sink without explicit consent bound to the data scope, recipient, purpose and expiry.

After revocation acknowledgement, no queued or in-flight operation relying on the revoked authority completes. Operations committed before the defined revocation boundary must be separately identified, not counted as post-revocation.
Unknown or malformed policy, policy timeout, schema/version mismatch or unavailable policy service yields deny/no-op, never implicit allow.

suites.method: For allowed, denied, malformed, expired, revoked and policy-failure requests, capture pre/post state digests, share-queue writes, privileged-action traces and observable network/IPC flows. Preserve raw event traces and capsule references. A side-effect channel that cannot be observed makes the result blocked/unclassified; missing telemetry is never interpreted as zero.
suites.notes: This is a future activation contract, not evidence that the current runtime enforces the property. A deny response alone is insufficient; a passing result must reconcile observable side-effect channels and state transitions.

suites.source: Offline/local fixture with network requests observable at the process boundary

metrics.pass_condition: No unexpected outbound connection/request is emitted during an explicitly offline/local-only scenario.

suites.method: Run with network blocked and an observable egress boundary; distinguish deliberate loopback fixture traffic from outbound egress.
suites.notes: A pass requires observable network enforcement, not just an absence of requests in application logs.

suites.source: Prism desktop host plus pinned local fixture

metrics.pass_condition: P95 target ≤ 3,000 ms on the declared reference machine; calibrate after initial 30-sample baseline.

suites.method: Measure process launch to first correct, nonblank, usable frame. Each cold sample starts a fresh process; record p50/p95 and raw samples.
suites.notes: Provisional product target, not a measured result. Fix the reference machine and power/thermal conditions before locking the budget.

suites.source: Pinned deterministic small local HTML/CSS fixture

metrics.pass_condition: P95 target ≤ 500 ms for a defined small local static fixture after the renderer slice exists.

suites.method: Start navigation from the same local fixture; end only after a correctness assertion and render-completion signal. Do not substitute a fixed sleep.
suites.notes: A deterministic local latency target, not a public-site or network-latency claim.

metrics.pass_condition: P95 target ≤ 100 ms for a declared, supported interaction on reference hardware.

suites.method: Measure from a trusted injected input event to a frame containing the expected visible state change; retain raw per-event durations.
suites.notes: Do not enable this target until the tested interaction path and rendering-completion signal are implemented.

suites.source: Process-tree RSS sampled over a fixed local-fixture workload

metrics.pass_condition: P95 process-tree resident set ≤ 500 MiB on the reference workload and hardware.

suites.method: Record renderer plus helper process tree, peak RSS and time series; report cold and steady-state separately.
suites.notes: Provisional budget only; validate against process-isolation design and realistic page workload before locking.

suites.source: Same Ladybird revision, fixture manifest, environment and measurement harness with/without Prism host adapter

metrics.pass_condition: Prism host adapter adds no more than 5% p95 latency against the matched standalone-Ladybird baseline, once comparable integration paths exist.

suites.method: Paired A/B runs in randomized order against the identical engine SHA, fixtures and reference environment. Publish both raw distributions.
suites.notes: Do not compare different engine revisions or machines and attribute the difference to adapter overhead.

suites.source: Pinned fixture corpus, process supervisor and crash/timeout detection

metrics.pass_condition: No renderer/host crash in a 10,000-case deterministic soak; each timeout is separately reported and triaged.
No timeout is silently discarded or treated as pass.

suites.method: Run in isolated worker processes with per-case timeout, crash capture, fixture hash and deterministic replay record.
suites.notes: A zero-crash soak is not a memory-safety proof and does not replace fuzzing or security review.

metrics.pass_condition: Once supported, publish version-pinned aggregate and per-workload results with raw JSON; set no comparative score target until the run is valid.

suites.method: Use official Speedometer 3.1 workload, clean profile, focused device and pinned harness revision; publish harness warnings and detailed subtest results.
suites.notes: This exercises end-to-end web-application responsiveness. Do not report a score if workloads produce missing durations or required APIs are unimplemented.

metrics.pass_condition: Once JavaScript/WebAssembly workloads are genuinely supported, publish version-pinned score and subtest output; do not fabricate missing-workload scores.

suites.method: Pin JetStream 2.2, use a clean environment, preserve subtest data and do not compare scores from different JetStream versions.
suites.notes: Not applicable to the current Prism runtime until the required scripting/runtime capabilities exist.

metrics.pass_condition: Once graphics/animation workloads are valid, publish version-pinned result and subtests; document display refresh rate and graphics backend.

suites.method: Pin MotionMark version and display refresh-rate protocol; record GPU backend, screen resolution and per-suite results.
suites.notes: MotionMark targets graphics/paining throughput rather than serving as a general browser correctness or security score.
